question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer

question: How many tracks are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track

question: List the names of all genres.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre

question: What are the names of the 5 longest tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many customers are from Brazil?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: What is the total revenue across all invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice

question: How many employees work at the company?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee

question: How many albums are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album

question: Which country has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks are in the Rock genre?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'

question: List the titles of all albums by AC/DC.
gold_sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: Which artist has the most albums?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) AS AlbumCount FROM Artist ar JOIN Album a ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which employee supports the most customers? Give the first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many invoices were billed to Germany?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'Germany'

question: Which media type is used by the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(t.MediaTypeId) AS TrackCount FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks are on the playlist named 'Classical'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Classical'

question: How much has the customer Frank Harris spent in total?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.Total) FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.FirstName = 'Frank' AND c.LastName = 'Harris'

question: List the names of the tracks on the album 'Let There Be Rock'.
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total spending? Give first name, last name and total.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which genre has the highest average track length?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, AVG(t.Milliseconds) AS AvgLength FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY AvgLength DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which artist has generated the most sales revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: In which year was total invoice revenue the highest?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS InvoiceYear, SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY InvoiceYear ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have spent more than 40 in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING SUM(Total) > 40)

question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine)

question: Which genre has sold the most tracks (by quantity)?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) AS TotalTracks FROM Track t JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY TotalTracks DESC LIMIT 1
